tagline: REXR is a self-administered and self-managed REIT focused on owning, operating, and acquiring industrial properties in Southern California infill markets to generate attractive risk-adjusted returns.
hero_kpi_rationale: REXR's portfolio, measured in millions of square feet of leasable space, is the primary indicator of its size and reach in the Southern California industrial real estate market.

kpis.signal: 51.2 million square feet portfolio in high-barrier markets.

kpis.name: Number of Properties

kpis.description: Indicates the extent and diversification of the real estate portfolio of 419 properties.

kpis.name: Total Debt

kpis.description: Represents the company's overall consolidated indebtedness.

kpis.name: Fixed-Rate Debt %
